capabilities: generate a styled image card from selected text or the block under the cursor
clean Markdown syntax from captured text and render emphasis correctly
detect attribution from cite elements, frontmatter, callout titles, headings, or the filename
extract a contrast-checked color palette from the cover image via median-cut quantisation
save, copy, or embed the image in four aspect ratios and three styles
disambiguation: Not a quote-capture or Readwise-sync tool; it only renders text already in your notes into images.
extras: Discloses that the implementation was almost entirely written with Claude Code. No telemetry, accounts, or paid tier; the only network activity is fetching a note's cover image URL. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.

motivation: The author liked Readwise's 'pretty image' highlight export and wanted the same for any quote already in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a passage from a note into a polished, shareable image for social media or presentations.
